youtube.title: Abraham Lincoln's excuse for not texting back 💀 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Abraham Lincoln left a client on read for weeks. His excuse was a HAT 🎩

What's YOUR worst late-reply excuse? Comment it 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: in a real letter of 27 June 1850 to Richard S. Thomas, Lincoln apologized for answering late: he had put the letter in his old hat, bought a new hat the next day, and the letter was "lost sight of for a time." Ten years later he was elected president.
